name: berean
description: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.

interface.shortDescription: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.
interface.longDescription: Berean checks protocol-agent releases without rerunning the model. A release pins its corpus by digest, proves citations against exact bytes, binds each live value to a chain and block, separates source classes, records refusals, and preserves the evaluation, promotion, or rollback decision. The Wildcat reference pins three captured official documents and five fixed-block market calls, with an unsigned Ariadne binding. Its authored answers keep the demonstration mixed; it establishes no live model behaviour.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $berean to verify this release's citations, chain readings and promotion record against its pinned corpus.
